reply:
idal terms.

Every other candidate I tried (logistic/Gompertz-style P·log P forms, exponential saturation in t, free exponents) landed between 2.3e-1 and 2.7e-3. The best one, the sinusoidal fit, is only a modest gain, so I cannot say whether the oscillation is real or just an artifact of the basis.

best.code:
def equation(t,P,params):
    a,b,c,d,e,f,h,g,k,m=params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    s=np.sin(g*t); co=np.cos(g*t)
    return a*np.log(1+t) + b*P + c*P**2 + d*t*P + e*t*P**2 + f*s + h*co + k*P*s + m*P*co
